name: The inter-section panel on neighbourhood transport fares
subject: debate
brief: Three of you represent Section A in an inter-section economics panel on feeder-auto and bus fares at the Nabapara Bus Stand: presenting the commuter survey, defending the stage-fare table, and fielding floor questions. You are the scribe, and the corridor outside the hall has nowhere quiet to spread out the sheets.

tasks.name: Present the fifty-rider morning commuter survey
Walk through the stage-fare comparison table
Note and answer questions from the floor

facts.text: The commerce department allows only 60 rupees for panel handouts, and forty cyclostyled sheets plus card folders would cost 95 rupees
Tara rides the Route 2B auto from the canal bridge every wet morning

note: Uses the Nabapara Bus Stand (loc_bus_hub), Ishan Sheikh (npc_ishan_sheikh), and Tara Das (npc_tara_das) from INDIA_WORLD_BIBLE.md. The constraint is the 60-rupee handout reproduction budget known to Ishan.
